integrity: All-n conclusions have a symbolic Fourier-block and scalar-optimization proof. Direct incidence-matrix checks are finite corroboration only. Independent validation and independent audit have not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Unnormalized coset sums on dihedral groups of order \(2n\), \(n\ge3\); weights are positive scalars common to each of three complete maximal-cyclic direction families. No claim about individual-row weighting or non-coset designs. Earlier equivalent weighted cycle/tomography results cannot be ruled out by bounded research.
title: Three-direction dihedral Radon tomography: exact nullities, singular spectra, and optimal weights
